The dish looks like baked or roll-style eggplant, with three pieces on a square plate. Using the plate as a ruler, I took it as roughly 26 cm across the diagonal, or about 22 cm per side. Each piece measures about 6-7 cm by 4 cm, and they are thin, so the three together come to roughly 100-120 g. The pieces look like eggplant rolls with cheese or a batter coating, which would put them at about 1.7 kcal/g, or around 190 kcal in total.
